warnings: Footing details of the main building, long-pile system (ฐานรากแบบเข็มยาว) — the system the notes make current: item 1 specifies prestressed piles 21.00 m and the handwritten item 7 says the department has required 21.00 m piles since FY2539. The short-pile alternative (same marks F1/F2, different members) is in _view2 so the marks never collide on one file (section 0.3).
All bars printed with ø → type RB (section 0.6). No concrete strength or steel grade printed on this sheet.
F2 prints two bar sets of different diameters (9 ø15 and 7 ø19) — recorded per section 0.5 (count = sum 16, dia_mm = first, mixed_dia_mm).
ขยาย C1 / ขยาย C2 are the column sections of this sheet (C2 0.50 x 0.30 'แกน = 6-ø25 มม.', handwritten — flagged).
